name: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood
label: Quest
description: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thank the spirits, friend. They are the ones that have come to your aid, not me.
I give this purified water to you now. Please give my regards to Greta and my best wishes. She is tackling something greater than many of us... As I'm sure she will soon find out.
The Shadow Council is not a force to be trifled with, friend. Remember that.
Go now. Take the water and return to Greta.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, I see you've returned, friend. Good. Did you find Islen in the Barrens? Or do we have to find another way to accomplish our goals?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This should be more than enough water for our purposes.

I'm glad to hear that Islen was able to help us. Her strength with the water spirits has always been a strong one. She is also wise, and rare is it that the spirits do not agree with her purpose. The fact that both of them have blessed our task gives me hope that we are on the right path.
